authorize.title: Sign in to Sogedo
authorize.description:
**Step 1 — Open the Sogedo login page**

[**Open the Sogedo login page**]({authorize_url})

If the link does not open, copy this address into your browser: `{authorize_url}`

**Step 2 — Log in** with your Sogedo account (email and password).

**Step 3 — Copy the address.** After logging in you land on a page that may look empty; its address bar then contains `code=...`. **Copy the entire address** (Ctrl/Cmd + C).

**Step 4 — Paste** it in the field below and click **Submit**.

data.code: Authorization code (or the full redirect address)

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.description: Select the water subscription to monitor.

error.no_code: No authorization code was found. Copy the full address bar of the page you were redirected to.
error.state_mismatch: This code was not issued from the link above. Open the link again, log in, and paste the new address.
error.invalid_code: The code is invalid or has expired. Open the link again, log in, and paste a fresh code.

abort.already_configured: This Sogedo account is already configured.
